items: A guest whose complaint is resolved well can become more loyal than one who never had a problem, so treat your complaint queue as a retention opportunity.
In Momos data from a QSR brand with 100+ locations, guests who redeemed a recovery offer returned more often than happy guests and those who never used their offer.
Sending an offer is only half the job: loyalty comes from redemption, so follow up by SMS or email with guests who haven't used their offer yet.
Run recovery as a repeatable loop: respond within 24 hours, send one simple offer tied to a return visit, then nudge guests who haven't redeemed.
Automate the loop so offers and follow-ups go out whether or not a store manager is on top of it that day.
